input.summary: Ported saxpy.cu to SYCL 2020 in port/saxpy.cpp. It has no dpct headers, no DPCT_* macros and no dpct:: calls. It uses sycl::queue with enable_profiling, malloc_shared/free for the unified buffers, a 1-D nd_range<1> parallel_for with the same 256-thread groups and a rounded-up global size, a bounds check on i < n, and event profiling for kernel_ms. Errors go through sycl::exception and std::exception handlers. The file compiles cleanly with icpx -fsycl (0 errors, 0 warnings) to build/candidate, with add_dpct_include=false. Numerical correctness is not verified by a run: no run/verify tool was available in this session. By inspection the arithmetic matches the reference (a*x[i]+y[i] in float, same inputs and initialization), so differences should be at most about one ulp, within atol 1e-6 for these value ranges, but this should be confirmed by running the binary and comparing output to the CUDA reference.
